name: Consumed By Fel leaves Immolation's tick damage unchanged and speeds up its tick interval (#1604)
contract: Consumed By Fel 300485 has two SPELLMOD_DAMAGE/SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME (op0/op19) percent SpellMods matching each spell's family20 classMask3 bits 9 and 11. The DAMAGE mod on Immolation (800208) stores EffectBasePoints -1 with DieSides 1, which SpellEffectInfo::CalcValue resolves to 0 (the -1 -> 0 rounding case), so it leaves Immolation's direct-damage tick unchanged (0%), not the '-1%' the tooltip implies. The ACTIVATION_TIME mod on Immolation Aura (800207) stores EffectBasePoints -26, DieSides 1 -> CalcValue -25, shortening its 3000ms tick interval by 25%, not 26%.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
Base Immolation tick damage is unaffected
Consumed By Fel's Immolation tick-damage modifier resolves to 0% (EffectBasePoints -1, DieSides 1 -> CalcValue 0)
